key_insight: LeVo 2 combines hierarchical modeling with progressive post-training to generate full-length songs that are both structurally coherent and rich in vocal/accompaniment detail. It aims to resolve the trade-off between preserving musical coordination and capturing track-specific acoustics.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the challenge of generating complete songs that stay coherent over long durations while accurately following lyrics/prompts and rendering high-quality vocals and accompaniment. Existing methods either lose detail with mixed-token modeling or sacrifice global planning and sequence efficiency with dual-track prediction.
method: Uses a hybrid LLM-Diffusion framework for controllable full-length song generation.
Introduces hierarchical representation modeling to better capture song structure and track-specific details.
Applies progressive post-training to improve stability, musicality, and alignment with lyrics/prompts.
impact: This work is important for practitioners building generative audio systems because it offers a path toward longer, more controllable, and more realistic song generation. It also suggests a practical way to balance global coherence with fine-grained audio fidelity in multi-track music models.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing LLM + diffusion components and data flow.
Side-by-side comparison of mixed-token vs dual-track vs LeVo 2 generation strategies.
Hierarchy chart illustrating song-level, section-level, and track-level representations.
Audio waveform/spectrogram icons representing vocals and accompaniment quality.
paper_title: LeVo 2: Stable and Melodious Song Generation via Hierarchical Representation Modeling and Progressive Post-Training
paper_authors: Shun Lei, Huaicheng Zhang, Dapeng Wu, Yaoxun Xu, Lishi Zuo
